dedupe_keys.name: cloudscene directory of data centres and service providers

description: Cloudscene is a commercial marketplace and directory that lists data centres, colocation facilities, network fabrics and connectivity, cloud and managed service providers worldwide, for buyers selecting providers. Market pages give counts and profiles by country and city; for the United States, for example, it listed 5,427 data centres, 3,259 service providers, 726 colocation providers, 1,755 connectivity providers and 86 network fabrics in September 2026, with the leading markets, total colocation power (about 14,843 MW), rack power ranges and an average power usage effectiveness of 1.43, and facility pages give operator, address and the providers present. The site claims more than 11,400 vendors globally and publishes rankings of leading data-centre operators. Coverage: worldwide by country and metro area, continuously updated by operators' listings. Format and access: web pages free to browse after joining, with procurement services and marketplace listings sold to vendors; no open bulk download or public API. Caveats: listings are self-reported and commercially motivated; terms of use restrict scraping; figures are not audited. Simulation uses: an inventory of data-centre locations and interconnection ecosystems for hazard exposure and capacity studies of digital infrastructure. Related records: PeeringDB gives open facility and exchange data, and the EU data-centre database gives energy reporting.
